user.title: Add a Huawei HiLink Opple light
user.description: Connect directly to the light over the local network. The auth code remains in Home Assistant and is never sent to third parties.

data_description.host: Reserve this IP address in your router before adding the light.
data_description.auth_code: Hexadecimal local-control key obtained from Huawei Smart Life.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read the light over the local network.
error.invalid_auth: The light rejected this local auth code.
